title: PRIME: Towards Verifiable Evidence-Grounded Reasoning in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents are used to check records against an organization's requirements, for example whether a vulnerability report is ready for investigation. Requirements often allow several ways to be met, such as a severity rating with a curator-reviewed advisory or a published advisory link. Agents fail by accepting a report after a required check has failed, or by settling for a weaker conclusion without trying another way that could still succeed. We introduce PRIME (Precommitted Rules for Inference from Minimal Evidence). Before checking, it fixes evidence routes specifying how each conclusion may be justified. A separate program records each check result and refuses any conclusion the results do not justify. It also points the agent to checks that could justify a stronger conclusion, or runs them itself. translated_title: PRIME：迈向大语言模型智能体中可验证的基于证据的推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体被用于根据组织的要求检查记录，例如判断一份漏洞报告是否已准备好进行调查。要求通常允许多种满足方式，例如带有策展人审核公告的严重性评级，或已发布的公告链接。智能体的失败方式包括：在必需检查失败后仍然接受报告，或者满足于较弱的结论而不尝试另一种仍可能成功的方式。我们提出了PRIME（基于最小证据的预提交推理规则）。在检查之前，它会固定证据路线，明确规定每个结论如何才能被证明合理。一个独立的程序记录每次检查的结果，并拒绝任何结果无法支持的结论。它还会向智能体指出可以证明更强结论的检查，或者自己运行这些检查。PRIME只报告由其规则和结果账本授权的结论。在要求正确、检查在已知位置精确执行且充分……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: PRIME通过预先固定证据路线并使用独立程序记录检查结果，确保LLM智能体只报告被规则和结果账本授权的结论，从而避免在必需检查失败后仍接受报告或满足于过弱的结论。
en_tdlr: PRIME precommits evidence routes and uses an independent program to record check results, ensuring LLM agents only report conclusions authorized by its rules and ledger, thereby preventing acceptance of reports after failed checks or settling for weaker conclusions without trying alternatives.
